note: Test reply: letters over three days, sources, contradictory sightings, answers to T0-1 and T0-3. Illustrative.

remarks: Count Starhemberg was not pleased to learn of your inquiry into the chests from a clerk rather than from you.
The two reports of Prussian regiments cannot both be right; the merchant has been wrong before.

reports.title: Three accounts, not one
reports.text: The Hofkammer separates what is promised, what the estates have granted and what lies in the chests. The last is the smallest figure by far.

reports.title: Regiments at Crossen
reports.text: A Breslau merchant swears he saw Prussian regiments in quarters about Crossen, more than he could count.

reports.title: Nothing at Crossen
reports.text: Our hussar patrol rode to within sight of Crossen and found the usual garrison only. The regiments are said to be nearer Berlin.

sighting.what: Prussian regiments, said to be near Berlin

reports.title: Boats at Linz
reports.text: Forty-one boats are counted at Linz and held; the boatmen ask who will pay their hire.
